query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_MAPDEF ( MAPID , WAFER_SIZE , CHIP_SIZE_X , CHIP_SIZE_Y , ORIGIN_MICRO_X , ORIGIN_MICRO_Y , ORIGIN_INDEX_X , ORIGIN_INDEX_Y , FIRST_MICRO_X , FIRST_MICRO_Y , FIRST_INDEX_X , FIRST_INDEX_Y , EDGE_SIZE , ANGLE , NETDIE , NOTCH_TYPE , ST_START , ST_INTYPE , ST_XCNT , ST_YCNT , ST_START_X , ST_START_Y , DIE_INDEX_MIN_X , DIE_INDEX_MAX_X , DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y , DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y , XY_DIRECTION , REFERENCEDIE_SETTING , DELETE_FLAG ) VALUES( :mapid ,:wafer_size ,:chip_size_x ,:chip_size_y ,:origin_micro_x ,:origin_micro_y ,:origin_index_x ,:origin_index_y ,:first_micro_x ,:first_micro_y ,:first_index_x ,:first_index_y ,:edge_size ,:angle ,:netdie ,:notch_type ,:st_start ,:st_intype ,:st_xcnt ,:st_ycnt ,:st_start_x ,:st_start_y ,:die_index_min_x ,:die_index_max_x ,:die_index_min_y ,:die_index_max_y ,:xy_direction ,:referance_setting , 'N')

SELECT FACTORY, MAPID, WAFER_SIZE, CHIP_SIZE_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y, ORIGIN_MICRO_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y - ORIGIN_MICRO_Y AS ORIGIN_MICRO_Y, ORIGIN_INDEX_X, ORIGIN_INDEX_Y, FIRST_MICRO_X, FIRST_MICRO_Y, FIRST_INDEX_X, FIRST_INDEX_Y, EDGE_SIZE, ANGLE, NETDIE, NETSHOT, NOTCH_TYPE, ST_START, ST_INTYPE, ST_XCNT, ST_YCNT, ST_START_X, ST_START_Y, DIE_INDEX_MIN_X, DIE_INDEX_MAX_X, DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y, DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y, XY_DIRECTION, REFERENCEDIE_SETTING, CASE WHEN DELETE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END DELETE_FLAG, TO_CHAR(INSERT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') INSERT_TIME, INSERT_USER, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE 1 = 1 AND MAPID = :MAPID --AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y'
SELECT MAPID FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE NVL(DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY MAPID

UPDATE TQP_MAPDEF SET WAFER_SIZE =:wafer_size ,CHIP_SIZE_X =:chip_size_x ,CHIP_SIZE_Y =:chip_size_y ,ORIGIN_MICRO_X =:origin_micro_x ,ORIGIN_MICRO_Y =:origin_micro_y ,ORIGIN_INDEX_X =:origin_index_x ,ORIGIN_INDEX_Y =:origin_index_y ,FIRST_MICRO_X =:first_micro_x ,FIRST_MICRO_Y =:first_micro_y ,FIRST_INDEX_X =:first_index_x ,FIRST_INDEX_Y =:first_index_y ,EDGE_SIZE =:edge_size ,ANGLE =:angle ,NETDIE =:netdie ,NOTCH_TYPE =:notch_type ,ST_START =:st_start ,ST_INTYPE =:st_intype ,ST_XCNT =:st_xcnt ,ST_YCNT =:st_ycnt ,ST_START_X =:st_start_x ,ST_START_Y =:st_start_y ,DIE_INDEX_MIN_X =:die_index_min_x ,DIE_INDEX_MAX_X =:die_index_max_x ,DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y =:die_index_min_y ,DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y =:die_index_max_y ,XY_DIRECTION = : xy_direction WHERE MAPID = :mapid
UPDATE TQP_MAPDEF SET DELETE_FLAG = 'Y', UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATE_USER = :update_user WHERE MAPID=:mapid
SELECT NETDIE FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE UPPER(MAPID) = UPPER(:mapid) AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y'

SELECT FACTORY, MAPID, WAFER_SIZE, CHIP_SIZE_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y, ORIGIN_MICRO_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y - ORIGIN_MICRO_Y AS ORIGIN_MICRO_Y, ORIGIN_INDEX_X, ORIGIN_INDEX_Y, FIRST_MICRO_X, FIRST_MICRO_Y, FIRST_INDEX_X, FIRST_INDEX_Y, EDGE_SIZE, ANGLE, NETDIE, NETSHOT, NOTCH_TYPE, ST_START, ST_INTYPE, ST_XCNT, ST_YCNT, ST_START_X, ST_START_Y, DIE_INDEX_MIN_X, DIE_INDEX_MAX_X, DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y, DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y, XY_DIRECTION, REFERENCEDIE_SETTING, DELETE_FLAG, INSERT_TIME, INSERT_USER, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE 1 = 1 AND UPPER(MAPID) = UPPER(:mapid) AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y'

SELECT A.FACTORY, A.MAPID, A.WAFER_SIZE, A.CHIP_SIZE_X, A.CHIP_SIZE_Y, A.ORIGIN_MICRO_X, A.CHIP_SIZE_Y - ORIGIN_MICRO_Y AS ORIGIN_MICRO_Y, A.ORIGIN_INDEX_X, A.ORIGIN_INDEX_Y, A.FIRST_MICRO_X, A.FIRST_MICRO_Y, A.FIRST_INDEX_X, A.FIRST_INDEX_Y, A.EDGE_SIZE, A.ANGLE, A.NETDIE, A.NETSHOT, A.NOTCH_TYPE, A.ST_START, A.ST_INTYPE, A.ST_XCNT, A.ST_YCNT, A.ST_START_X, A.ST_START_Y, A.DIE_INDEX_MIN_X, A.DIE_INDEX_MAX_X, A.DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y, A.DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y, A.XY_DIRECTION, A.REFERENCEDIE_SETTING, A.DELETE_FLAG, A.INSERT_TIME, A.INSERT_USER, A.UPDATE_TIME, A.UPDATE_USER FROM TQP_MAPDEF A, TQP_PRODUCT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.MAPID = B.MAPID AND B.PRODUCT = :LotId AND NVL(A.DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y'

INSERT INTO TQP_MAPDEF VALUES(:mapid ,:wafer_size ,:chip_size_x ,:chip_size_y ,:origin_micro_x ,:origin_micro_y ,:origin_index_x ,:origin_index_y ,:first_micro_x ,:first_micro_y ,:first_index_x ,:first_index_y ,:edge_size ,:angle ,:netdie ,:notch_type ,:st_start ,:st_intype ,:st_xcnt ,:st_ycnt ,:st_start_x ,:st_start_y ,:die_index_min_x ,:die_index_max_x ,:die_index_min_y ,:die_index_max_y ,:xy_direction ,:referance_setting)
SELECT FACTORY, MAPID, DIE_TYPE, TO_NUMBER(DIE_NO) DIE_NO, INDEX_X, INDEX_Y FROM TQP_MAPDEF_DIE WHERE MAPID = :MAPID AND DIE_TYPE = 'DIE'
SELECT INDEX_X, INDEX_Y, 1 AS TEST FROM TQP_MAPDEF_DIE WHERE MAPID = :MAPID AND DIE_TYPE = 'DIE'

SELECT MAPID AS SETUP_ID, ANGLE, WAFER_SIZE, NOTCH_TYPE, CHIP_SIZE_X AS DIE_PITCH_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y AS DIE_PITCH_Y, ORIGIN_INDEX_X AS DIE_ORIGIN_X, ORIGIN_INDEX_Y AS DIE_ORIGIN_Y, ORIGIN_MICRO_X AS ORIGIN_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y - ORIGIN_MICRO_Y AS ORIGIN_Y FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE 1 = 1 AND MAPID = :MAPID AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y'

SELECT FACTORY, MAPID, WAFER_SIZE, CHIP_SIZE_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y, ORIGIN_MICRO_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y - ORIGIN_MICRO_Y AS ORIGIN_MICRO_Y, ORIGIN_INDEX_X, ORIGIN_INDEX_Y, FIRST_MICRO_X, FIRST_MICRO_Y, FIRST_INDEX_X, FIRST_INDEX_Y, EDGE_SIZE, ANGLE, NETDIE, NETSHOT, NOTCH_TYPE, ST_START, ST_INTYPE, ST_XCNT, ST_YCNT, ST_START_X, ST_START_Y, DIE_INDEX_MIN_X, DIE_INDEX_MAX_X, DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y, DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y, XY_DIRECTION, REFERENCEDIE_SETTING, DELETE_FLAG, TO_CHAR(INSERT_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS INSERT_TIME, INSERT_USER, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY MAPID
SELECT MAPID, CASE WHEN DELETE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN MAPID || ' (USER)' ELSE MAPID END DISP_MAPID FROM TQP_MAPDEF ORDER BY 1
SELECT 1 FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE FACTORY = :FACTORY AND MAPID = :MAPID

INSERT INTO TQP_MAPDEF ( FACTORY, MAPID , WAFER_SIZE , CHIP_SIZE_X , CHIP_SIZE_Y , ORIGIN_MICRO_X , ORIGIN_MICRO_Y , ORIGIN_INDEX_X , ORIGIN_INDEX_Y , EDGE_SIZE , ANGLE , NOTCH_TYPE , DIE_INDEX_MIN_X , DIE_INDEX_MAX_X , DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y , DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y , XY_DIRECTION, INSERT_TIME, INSERT_USER, DELETE_FLAG ) VALUES( :factory ,:mapid ,:wafer_size ,:chip_size_x ,:chip_size_y ,:origin_micro_x ,:chip_size_y - :origin_micro_y ,:origin_index_x ,:origin_index_y ,:edge_size ,0 ,0 ,:die_index_min_x ,:die_index_max_x ,:die_index_min_y ,:die_index_max_y ,0 ,SYSDATE ,:create_user ,'Y' )

UPDATE TQP_MAPDEF SET WAFER_SIZE = :wafer_size, CHIP_SIZE_X = :chip_size_x, CHIP_SIZE_Y = :chip_size_y, ORIGIN_MICRO_X = :origin_micro_x, ORIGIN_MICRO_Y = :chip_size_y - :origin_micro_y, ORIGIN_INDEX_X = :origin_index_x, ORIGIN_INDEX_Y = :origin_index_y, EDGE_SIZE = :edge_size, DIE_INDEX_MIN_X = :die_index_min_x, DIE_INDEX_MAX_X = :die_index_max_x, DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y = :die_index_min_y, DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y = :die_index_max_y WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND MAPID = :mapid
DELETE FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND MAPID = :mapid

SELECT FACTORY, MAPID, WAFER_SIZE, CHIP_SIZE_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y, ORIGIN_MICRO_X, CHIP_SIZE_Y - ORIGIN_MICRO_Y AS ORIGIN_MICRO_Y, ORIGIN_INDEX_X, ORIGIN_INDEX_Y, FIRST_MICRO_X, FIRST_MICRO_Y, FIRST_INDEX_X, FIRST_INDEX_Y, EDGE_SIZE, ANGLE, NETDIE, NETSHOT, NOTCH_TYPE, ST_START, ST_INTYPE, ST_XCNT, ST_YCNT, ST_START_X, ST_START_Y, DIE_INDEX_MIN_X, DIE_INDEX_MAX_X, DIE_INDEX_MIN_Y, DIE_INDEX_MAX_Y, XY_DIRECTION, REFERENCEDIE_SETTING, CASE WHEN DELETE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END DELETE_FLAG, TO_CHAR(INSERT_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') INSERT_TIME, INSERT_USER, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE 1 = 1 AND MAPID = :MAPID AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y'

SELECT -1 AS WAFER_SEQ, DIE_NO AS DIE_NUM, 'AVI' AS TEST_AREA, 0 AS DIEPROBE_CNT, INDEX_X AS X, INDEX_Y AS Y, 0 AS BIN, '0' AS BIN_CHAR, '' AS IMAGE_PATH, '' AS THUMB_PATH, '' AS IMAGE_FILE_NAME, '' AS THUMB_FILENAME FROM TQP_MAPDEF_DIE WHERE 1 = 1 AND MAPID = :mapid AND DIE_TYPE = 'DIE'
SELECT MAPID, CASE WHEN DELETE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN MAPID || ' (USER)' ELSE MAPID END DISP_MAPID FROM TQP_MAPDEF WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(DELETE_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY 1
